premises.claim: expiry can be publicly relabeled in the actual ciphertext encoding
evidence: TCC pp230,233 require expiry explicitly retrievable
p239 shows no separate authenticated expiry field or serialization
premises.derivation: Retrievability permits reading metadata; valid editable serialization requires an additional check. With an ordinary public unbound header, relabeling is available.
premises.missing: Complete encoding, parser and any binding/authentication steps

evidence: TCC p236 Gamma is a set of labels
p239 Enc uses the ordinary label-set difference
premises.derivation: Gamma_1={1,2}; Gamma_11={11,12,2}; Gamma_111={111,112,12,2}; both differences are {1}. Fixed-key, same-tape printed bodies are equal.

premises.claim: the relabeled ciphertext is distributed as a valid unexpired encryption
premises.derivation: P1 plus pointwise full-encoding equality gives this premise with epsilon_eq=0. Body equality alone leaves serialization/validation unresolved.

premises.missing: Total encoding/validation and the exact intended frontier operation

premises.claim: Delta3 performs the corresponding legitimate epoch-2-to-3 update
evidence: p238 child-label calculation omits the required root right-child node for K2
p239 update input/loop/output node domains differ
p240 correctness text uses the delegated destination node

premises.claim: K3 correctly decrypts the legitimately updated ciphertext
premises.derivation: The printed first two root slots give M/E(g0,h1), without an axiom forcing that residual to 1. A typed key/ciphertext invariant yields the usual full cancellation conditionally.
premises.missing: Verified base key layout and complete typed induction from actual Gen through K3

premises.claim: the R2-EXP query skeleton is legal in fixed EE-R-PA1
evidence: Frozen SECURITY_GAME.md: challenge at 2, expiry 2, key corruption only at 3
Local public computation is permitted; ordinary interface accepts no challenge import
